m: अन्-एधस् m. fire, L.
the wind, L.

v: tri॰ nidi kutsane kyap ni॰ nalopaguRO na॰ ta॰ । praSaste praDAne niruktakAraH ।
m: अ-नेद्य (4) mfn. (√ निद्), not to be blamed, RV.
a: अनेद्य — a. Ved. 1 Not to be blamed; praiseworthy, chief (प्रशस्त, प्रधान). --2 Not near; infinite.

s: [s] puM, (na hfnyate, na + han + asun pfzodarAditvAt han sTAne ehAdeSaH, tataH sOkfte anaNAdeSaH .) kAlaH । samayaH । ityamaraH ॥ (“tasTustasyAntike drohaSCidrAnehaHpratIkziRaH” । iti rAjataraNgiRI .)

k.v: कालो दिष्टोऽप्यनेहापि समयोऽप्यथ पक्षतिः।  प्रतिपद्द्वे इमे स्त्रीत्वे तदाद्यास्तिथयो द्वयोः॥

v: pu॰ na hanyate hana--asi prakfterehAdeSaH । kAle । sO anaN । anehA “kAloddizwo'pyanehApI” tyamaraH । na hanyate karmmaRi asi । ahiMsanIye tri॰ । “SamBuvaM mantraM devA anehasamiti” f॰ 1, 40, 6 । “anehasaM kenApyAhiMsyAmiti” BA॰ । “pApinovayam yajAmahe supratUrtimanehasam” f॰ 1, 40, 4 । “yaTA no'sme kzayAya DizaRe anehaH” f॰ 6, 503 ।
m: अन्-एहस् mfn. (√ ईह्), without a rival, incomparable, unattainable
unmenaced, unobstructed, RV.
अन्-एहस् (आ), m. time, Bālar.; BhP.
a: अनेहस् — a. [न हन्यते, हन्-असि, धातोः एहादेशः नञि हन एह च Uṇ. 4. 223] (lit.) Not killed or destroyed or obstructed; Ved. without a rival, incomparable, unattainable, inaccessible; unobstructed, not liable to be hurt or injured; शंभुवं मंत्रं देवा अनेहसं Rv. 1. 40. 6, 4; 6. 50. 3. --m. (हा-हसौ &c.) Time (not being liable to be destroyed).

v: na॰ na ejat । sarbDadEkarUpe brahmaRi । “anejadekaM manaso javIya” iti ISopa॰ । “ejanaM kampanaM svaBAvapracyutistadvivarjjitaM sarvvadA ekarUpamiti” BA॰ । kampanaSUnye tri॰ striyAM NIp ।
m: अन्-एजत् mfn. (√ एज्), not moving, immovable.
a: अनेजत् — a. [न एजत्] Not moving, immovable; of the same form, epithet of Brahma or the Supreme Soul (सर्वदैकरूपं ब्रह्म).

m: अनेकाश्रय or अनेकाश्रित, mfn. (in Vaiśeṣika phil.) dwelling or abiding in more than one.

v: pu॰ anekezu ASritaH 7 ta॰ । vESezikanaye saMyogAdizu, sAmAnyezu ca । “saMyogaSca viBAgaSca saMKyA dvitvAdikAstaTA । dvipfTaktvAdayastadvadete'nekASritA guRA” iti BAzA॰ “nityatve sati anekasavavetatvaM jAtitvamiti” muktA॰ । ekasyA eva vyakternAnAvyaktinizWatve'sya prayogopADitA । Bavanti ca saMyogAdayaH sAmAnyaM ca taTA । rUpAdernAnAvyaktizu sattve'pi nEkavyakteriti na tasya taTAtvamiti BedaH ।

s: puM, (anekAni ASritaH, dvitIyASritAtIta ityAdinA samAsaH, tAdfSaH guRaH karmmaDArayaH .) bahunizWaguRaH । tadyaTA । saMyogaH 1 viBAgaH 2 dvipfTaktvAdiH 3 ekatvAnyasaNKyA 4 । iti sidDAntamuktAvalI ॥ (“saMyogaSca viyogaSca saNKyA dvitvAdikAstaTA । dvipfTaktvAdayastadvadete'nekASritA guRAH” । iti BAzAparicCede .)

m: अनेकाच् mfn. having more than one vowel or syllable (अच् in Gr. being the technical term for vowel).
अनेकाग्र mfn. engaged in various pursuits.
अनेकाकार mfn. multiform.
अन्-एकाकिन् mfn. not alone, accompanied by, ŚBr.
a: अनेकाकिन् — a. Not alone, accompanied by.

m: अनेकाक्षर mfn. polysyllabic, having more than one syllable.
अनेकाल् mfn. consisting of more than one letter (अल् being the technical term for letter).

v: tri॰ na ekAnto niyamo avyaBicAro yatra । aniyame, aniScitaPalake ca । vyaBicAravati duzwahetO pu॰ । “anekAnto virudDaScApyasidDaH pratipakzitaH । kAlAtyayApadizwaSca hetvABAsASca paYcaDeti” BAzA॰ । saca triviDaH “AdyaH sADAraRastu syAdanyo'sADAraRo mataH । taTEvAnupasaMhArI triDA'nEkAntiko mata” iti BAzA॰ । ekAnto'styasya prajYA॰ Ra । EkAntaH na॰ ta॰ anEkAntopyatra kvacit “BAzAyAm anEkAnto virudDa Scetyeva” pAWaH । taTA ca sADAraRAditritayAnyAnyatvamanekAntatvam ।
m: अन्-एकान्त mfn. not alone and excluding every other, uncertain.
अन्-एकान्त—त्व n. uncertainty.
अन्-एकान्त—वाद m. scepticism.

v: pu॰ asti nAsti vetyekAntaM na vadati vada--Rini 6 ta॰ । bOdDaBede । tasya astinAstikAyavAditvena taTAtvaM vivaraRamarhacCabde dfSyam ।
m: अन्-एकान्त—वादिन् m. a sceptic
a Jaina, an Arhat of the Jainas.

v: tri॰ aneke arTA aBiDeyA yasya । nAnArTe Sabde । yaTA gavAdaya akzAdayaSca । “anekArTasya Sabdasya saMyogAdyErniyantrite । ekatrArTe'nyaDIheturvyaYjanA sABiDA Srayeti” sA॰ da॰ । ayamASayaH “saMyogaSca viBAgaSca sAhacaryyaM viroDitA । arTaH prakaraRaM liNgaM SabdasyAnyasya sanniDiH । sAmarTyamOcitI deSaH kAkvAdyuktiH svavAcakaH । SabdArTasyAnavacCede viSezasmftihetava” iti haryyukteranekArTaSabdAnAM sarvatra SaktO samAnAyAM satyAM, saMyogAdyEritarArTaboDapratiroDanena viSezArTa eva smAryyate । tadBinnArTasya tu vyaYjanayA boDaH ityalaNkArikARAM matam । taTAca saMyogAdayaH SaktyA anyArTopasTitO pratibanDakAH । vyaYjanA vfttyA tadupasTApane tu na । “anekArTaSabdeByaHsarvezAmarTAnAmaviSezeRopasTitO satyAmapi saMyogAdayaH anyaSakyavizayaSAbdaboDamAtraM pratibaDnanti natu vyaNgyavizayamiti” rasagaNgADaraH । nEyAyikAdayastu anekArTaSabdAnAM SakyatAcCedakalAGavalABe tatrEva Saktiranyatra lakzaRA tatra saMyogAdayaH anyArTaboDanaM nEva prativaGnanti । taTA ca saMyogAdayaH sati tAtparyye, tadvizayIBUtArTavizayasmftiM tajjanyAnvayabudDiM vA na prativaDnanti kintu tAtparyyamAtronnAyakA ityalaM vyaYjanAvfttyeti svIcakruriti BedaH । aneke arTAH prayojanAni yatra yasya vA । anekaprayojanavati tri॰ “anekArTABiyoge ca yAvatsaMsADayedDanI” iti smftiH । karmma॰ । vahuprayojane pu॰ ba॰ va॰ ।
m: अनेकार्थ mfn. having more than one meaning (as a word).
अनेकार्थ-ध्वनि-मञ्जरी, f. and अनेकार्थ-संग्रह,m., N. of two works on words.
अने—˚कात्म-वादिन् mfn. asserting a plurality of souls, Sāṃkhyas., Sch.
अनेकी-भवत् mfn. being manifold i.e. divided in two.
अनेकी-करण n. making manifold.

a: अनेकीकृ — or भू To make or be manifold; to divide or be divided into.

m: अनेकीय mfn. having several, (g. उत्करादि, q.v.)

s: tri, (ekasmAt anyat naYsamAsaH .) ekatvAtiriktasaMKyAnaM tadviSizwaYca । bahu । yaTA, -- “anekarAjanyaraTASvasaNkulaM” । iti BAraviH ॥
v: tri॰ na ekaH ekaBinnatayA utsargataH bahuvacanAntatA । bahusaMKyakezu । “anekAni sahasrARi kOmArabrahmacAriRA” miti manuH । “patantyaneke jalaDerivormayaH” iti mAGaH “aneke sevante BavadaDikagIrvARanivahAniti” SyAmAstrotram । ekaSabdasya sarvanAmatvena naYtatpuruze tadBinnavAcakatayA gORatve'pi atacCabdavat sarvanAmakAryyaM tena aneke iti, anekezAmiti, anekatretyAdi । evaYca ekaSabdasya samAhAradvigutvanizeDAdanekaSabdasya bahusaMKyAvAcakatve'pi na samAhAraH । tena anekarAjanyaraTASvasaNkulamiti kirA॰ samAhAre anekarAjanyaraTASvIti syAt । “yatrAnekaviDamAntaryyaM tatra sTAnata AntaryyaM balIya iti” pariBA॰ si॰ kO॰ । “anekapitfkAnAntu pitfto BAgakalpaneti” yAjYa॰ । “anekabAhUdaravaktranetramiti” “anekajanmasaMsidDastato yAti parAM gatimiti” ca gItA nAsti ekaH “dvyekayordvivacanEkavacane” itivat ekatvaM yatreti bahuvrIhO anekaSabdasya ekavacanAntatApIzyate । “anekamanyapadArTe” iti pA॰ sU॰ । “AkASamekaM hi yaTA GawAdizu pfTagBavet “taTAtmEko'pyanekaSceti” yAjYa॰ । “anekamASritaM liNgamiti” sA॰ kA॰ । “eko'nyArTe praDAne ca praTame kevale taTA । sADAraRe maNgale'lpe saMKyAyAYca prayujyate” ityuktezvarTezu ekaSabdasya vftteH taduktArTaBinne tri॰ । tatra ca saMKyAnyarTe eva bahuvacanAntatAnyatra yaTezwateti mano॰ । utkarAdi॰ BavArTe Ca । anekIyaH tadBave tri॰ । BAve vrA॰ । zyaY । anEkyaM bahutve na॰ ।
m: अन्-एक mfn. not one, many, much
separated.
a: अनेक — a. 1 Not one; more than one, many; अनेकपितृकाणां तु पितृतो भागकल्पना Y. 2. 120, Ki. 1. 16; several, various; तथात्मैकोऽप्यनेकश्च Y. 3. 144. --2 Separated; divided; oft. in comp.; ˚आकार having many shapes or forms; diverse, multiform; ˚कालं-वारं several times, many a time and oft; ˚भार्य having more wives than one. --Comp. --अक्षर, --अच् a. having more than one vowel or syllable; polysyllabic. --अग्र a. {1} engaged in several pursuits. {2} not concentrated or fixed on one object. --अंत a. {1} [न. ब.] not alone so as to exclude all others, uncertain, doubtful, variable; स्यादित्यव्ययमनेकांतवाचकं {2} = अनैकांतिक q. v. --(तः) {1} unsettled condition, absence of permanence. {2} uncertainty, doubtfulness. {3} an unessential part, as the several anubandhas. ˚वादः scepticism. ˚वादिन् m. a sceptic, a Jaina or an Arhat of the Jainas. --अर्थ a. {1} having many (more than one) meanings, homonymous; as the words गो, अमृत, अक्ष &c.; अनेकार्थस्य शब्दस्य K. P. 2. {2} having the sense of the word अनेक. {3} having many objects or purposes. --(र्थः) multiplicity of objects, topics &c. --अल् a. having more than one अल् (letter) P. I. 1. 55. --आश्रय, --आश्रित a. (in Vaiś. phil.) dwelling or abiding in more than one (such as संयोग, सामान्य); एतेऽनेकाश्रिता गुणाः Bhāṣā P.; dependence upon more than one. --कृत् m. ‘doing much’, N. of Śiva. --गुण a. of many kinds, manifold, diverse; विगणय्य कारणमनेकगुणं Ki. 6. 37. --गुप्तः N. of a king; ˚अर्चितपादपंकजः K. 3. --गोत्र a. belonging to two families (such as a boy when adopted), i. e. that of his own, and that of his adoptive, father. --चर a. gregarious. --चित्त a. not of one mind, fickle-minded; ˚मंत्रः not following the counsels of one; H. 4. 31. --ज a. born more than once. --(जः) a bird (गर्भांडाभ्यां जातत्वात्). --पः an elephant (so called because he drinks with his trunk and mouth); cf. द्विप; वन्येतरानेकपदर्शनेन R. 5. 47; Śi. 5. 35, 12. 75. --मुख a. (खी f.) a. {1} having many faces, many-faced. {2} scattered, dispersed, going in various directions, taking to various ways; (बलानि) जगाहिरेऽ नेकमुखानि मार्गान् Bk. 2. 54. --मूर्तिः ‘having many forms’, N. of Viṣṇu who assumed various forms to deliver the earth from calamities. --युद्धविजयिन्, --विजयिन् a. victorious in many battles; Pt. 3. 9, 11. --रूप a. {1} of various forms, multiform. {2} of various kinds or sorts. {3} fickle, changeable, of a varying nature; वेश्यांगनेव नृपनीतिरनेकरूपा Pt. 1. 425. --(पः) epithet of the Supreme Being. --लोचनः N. of Śiva; also of Indra, and of the Supreme Being, he being said to be सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् &c. --वचनं the plural number; dual also. --वर्ण a. involving more than one (unknown) quantity (the unknown quantities x. y. z. &c. being represented in Sanskrit by colours नील, काल &c.); ˚समीकरणं simultaneous equation; ˚गुणनं, ˚व्यवकलनं, ˚हारः multiplication, subtraction or division of unknown quantities. --विध a. various, different. --शफ a. cloven-hoofed. --शब्द a. synonymous. --साधारण a. common to many, the common property of many persons Dk. 83.

m: अन्-एक—भार्य mfn. having more wives than one.

s: vya, (aneka + prakArArTe DA .) anekaprakAraM । bahuDA । yaTA, -- “pAwIsUtropamaM vIjaM gUQamityavaBAzate । nAsti gUQamagUQAnAM nEva zoQetyanekaDA” ॥ iti lIlAvatI ॥ anekavArArTe'pi kvacitprayogaH ॥
v: avya॰ aneka + prakAre DAc । bahuprakAre “anekaDA kftAH putrA fziBirye purAtanEriti” smftiH । “tatrEkasTaM jagat kftsnaM praviBaktamanekaDeti” gItA ।
m: अन्-एक—धा ind. in various ways, often.
a: अनेकधा — ind. In various ways, variously; जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा Bg. 11. 13.

m: अन्-एक—धा-प्रयोग m. using repeatedly.
अन्-एक—धर्म-कथा f. different exposition of the law.
अनेक—धृत् m. N. of Rudra-Śiva, Hcat.

a: अनेकशः — ind. [वीप्सार्थे कारके शस्] 1 Several or many times, frequently; अनेकशो निर्जितराजकस्त्वं Bk. 2. 52. --2 In various ways or manners. --3 In large numbers or quantities; पुत्रा अनेकशो मृता दाराश्च H. 1.

m: अन्-एक—शफ mfn. cloven-hoofed, Pāṇ. i, 2, 73 Comm.
अन्-एक—शब्द mfn. expressed by several words, synonymous.

v: avya॰ aneka + vIpsArTe kArake Sas । anekavArArTe “anekaSo nirjjitarAjakastvaBiti” BawwiH ।
m: अन्-एक—शस् ind. in great numbers, several times, repeatedly.
अन्-एक—चर mfn. gregarious.
अन्-एक—चित्त-मन्त्र m. one whose counsels are many-minded.
अन्-एक—गोत्र m. having more families than one i.e. two, belonging to two families (or to one as an adopted son).

s: puM, (anekaM jAyate, aneka + jan + qaH upapadasamAsaH .) pakzI । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ bahujAte tri ॥
v: pu॰ anekavAraM jAyate jana--qa vfttO saMKyAvAcakasya sujarTatA । dvivAraM jAte pakziRi, tasya garBARqAByAM jAtatvena dvivArajAtatayA dvijatvAdanekajatvam । 5 ta॰ । bahuByo jAte tri॰ ।
m: अन्-एक—ज mfn. born more than once
अन्-एक—ज m. a bird, L.
अन्-एक—कालावधि ind. long since.
अन्-एक—कालम् ind. a long time, for a long time.
अन्-एक—काम (अनेक-) mfn. having many wishes, ŚBr.
अन्-एक—कृत् m. ‘doing much’, N. of Śiva.

v: pu॰ anekAni locanAni yasya । indre, parameSvare ca “sahasrAkzaH sahasrapAditi” SrutO anekavA hUdaravaktranetramiti” gItAyAYca tasya anekanetratvoktestaTAtvam
m: अन्-एक—लोचन m. ‘having several (three) eyes’, N. of Śiva.

v: pu॰ anekA lokAnAmanugrahAya avatArezu nAnAviDA mUrttayo'sya । parameSvare “anekamUrttiravyakta” iti vizRusaha॰ ।

m: अन्-एक—मुख mfn. having several faces, having different ways.

s: puM, (anekakAByAM muKaSURqAByAM pibati, aneka + pA + kaH, upapadasamAsaH .) hastI ityamaraH ॥
v: pu॰ anekAByAM muKaSuRqAByAM pibati pA--ka । dvipe hastini । “mAlavanATo'pyanekAnekapayUTasanATaH” da॰ ku॰ ।
m: अन्-एक—प mfn. ‘drinking oftener than once’, an elephant (because he drinks with his trunk and with his mouth), Ragh.

k.v: दन्ती दन्तावलो हस्ती द्विरदोऽनेकपो द्विपः। मतङ्गजो गजो नागः कुञ्जरो वारणः करी॥

v: pu॰ anekAni rUpARyasya । bahurUpe parameSvare “rUpaM rUpaM pratirUpo baBUveti” SrutO tasya bahurUpatvoktestaTAtvam । nAnAviDarUpayuktamAtre pawAdO tri॰ ।
m: अन्-एक—रूप mf(आ)n. multiform
of various kinds or sorts
fickle, of variable mind.
अन्-एक—रन्ध्र mfn. having many holes or weaknesses or troubles.
अनेक—संख्य mfn. very numerous, Kir.
अनेक—संस्थान mfn. wearing various disguises (as spies), Mn. ix, 261
अन्-एक—ता, f. or अन्-एक—त्व, n. muchness, manifold condition.
अन्-एक—त्र ind. in many places.
अन्-एक—वारम् ind. many times, repeatedly.
अनेक—वार्षिक mfn. many years old, R.
अन्-एक—वचन n. the pl. number.
अन्-एक—वर्ण (in algebra compounded with various words to denote) many unknown quantities (colours representing x, y, z, &c. e.g. अनेक-वर्ण-गुणन, multiplication of many unknown quantities).
अनेक—वर्ण mfn. many-coloured, Bhag.

v: na॰ anekavarRAH ajYAtaviSezasaMKyakAnekarASayaH samIkriyante jYAtasaMKyakasamatayA kriyante yatra । vIjaBede yaToktaM BAskaravIjagaRite “aTAnekavarRasamIkaraRaM vIjam । tatra sUtraM sArdDavfttatrayam .” “AdyaM varRRaM SoDayedanyapakzAdanyAn rUpARyanyataScAdyaBakte । pakze'nyasminnAdyavarRonmitiH syAdvarRasyEkasyonmitInAM bahutve ॥ samIkftacCedagame tu tAByastadanyavarRRonmitayaH prasADyAH । antyonmitO kuwwaviDerguRAptI te BAjyatadBAjakavarRRamAne ॥ anye'pi BAjye yadi santi varRRAstanmAnamizwaM parikalpya sADyam । vilomalotTApanato'nyavarRRamAnAni BinnaM yadi mAnamevam ॥ BUyaH kAryyaH kuwwako 'trAntyavarRRaM tenotTApyotTApayedvyastamAnAt” । “idamanekavarRRasamIkaraRaM vIjaM yatrodAharaRe dvitryAdayo'vyaktarASayo Bavanti tezAM yAvattAvadAdayo varRRAH mAnezu kalpyAstatra pUrvvAcAryyEH kalpitAH yAvattAvat, kAlaka, nIlaka, pItaka, lohitaka, Svetaka, citraka, kapilaka, piNgalaka, DUmraka, pAwalaka, Savalaka, SyAmalaka, mecakA, ityAdi । aTa vA kAdInyakzarARi avyaktAnAM saMjYAH asaNkarArTaM kalpyAH । ataH prAgvaduddeSakAlApavadviGiM kurvatA gaRakena pakzO samO kAryyO pakzA vA samAH kAryyAH । tataH sUtrAvatAro'yaM tayoH samayoranekasmAt pakzAditarapakzasyAdyaM varRRaM SoDayettadanyavarRAn rUpARi ca itarapakzAcCoDayettataH AdyavarRRaSezeRetarapakze Bakte BAjakavarRonmitiH । bahuzu pakzezu yayoryayoH sAgyamasti tayorevaM kfte sati anyA unmitayaH syuH ।
